description: Generates a text report of all installed software.

fields.name: OutputFile
fields.label: Report file
fields.helpText: Where the generated software inventory report is written.
fields.helpDetail: Columns are Name / Version / Arch / Source across dpkg, snap and flatpak sections. Registry-style Publisher/InstallDate columns have no Linux equivalent and are not emulated. Read-only report — no preview, nothing to undo.
